name: Award Winning Tiatr Festival
benefit:
##### ***Financial Remuneration for Tiatr Performance***

- Tiatr Academy of Goa Popular Tiatr winners: ₹40,000/- for each tiatr.
- Kala Academy Group 'A' winners: ₹35,000/- for each tiatr.
- Kala Academy Group 'B' winners: ₹30,000/- for each tiatr.
- Tiatr Academy of Goa Children Tiatr winners: ₹25,000/- for each tiatr.

##### ***Infrastructure Support***

- Payment to service pro
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be the director/producer of a tiatr that has won 1st, 2nd or 3rd place in any of the following competitions: - The applicant must be the director/producer of a tiatr that won 1st, 2nd or 3rd prize in Tiatr Academy of Goa Popular Tiatr Competition. - The applicant must be the director/producer of a tiatr that won 1st, 2nd or 3rd prize in Kala Academy Group 'A' tiatr Competition. - The applicant must be the director/producer of a tiatr that won 1st, 2nd or 3rd prize in Kala Academy Group 'B' tiatr Competition. - The applicant must be the director/producer of a tiatr that won 1st, 2nd or 3rd prize in Tiatr Academy of Goa Children's Tiatr Competition. ***Post-Selection Conditions*** - Presentation of tiatr including kantaram should be done exactly the way it was presented in the respective competitions. - The tiatr should be shown without charging tickets. - Non-adherence to performance norms may result in withholding the payments. - Tiatr Academy of Goa may depute an observer to verify whether the performance is as per the norms.
